name: PdxAvatar
description: A user avatar that shows an image, or falls back to initials colored from the name.

members.name: src
members.description: Image URL; falls back to initials if it fails.

members.name: alt
members.description: The person's name: initials, accessible name and auto color. Without it, or with `decorative`, the avatar is aria-hidden.

members.name: color
members.description: 'auto' generates color from name. Or pass a CSS color. Default: 'auto'.

members.name: decorative
members.description:
Beside the person's name written out: the initials and the colour still come from `alt`, but
the avatar is aria-hidden, with no role or label, so the name is not read twice (#1054).

members.name: size
members.description: xs (24px), sm (32px), md (40px, the default), lg (48px) or xl (64px).

members.name: shape
members.description: circle (the default) or square (the theme's medium radius).
